_meta.description: Named scanner universes (SU-3). A universe is a union of symbol groups plus a named eligibility profile. Scanners reference a NAME; no scanner hardcodes a group or a filter, so adding a scanner is a config change. Group membership itself lives in the symbol_group table (SU-2), not here.
_meta.eligibility_note: Only 'none' is implemented today. Resolving a universe that names any other profile RAISES rather than returning unfiltered symbols — returning an unfiltered set under the name of a filtered universe is the silent-wrongness this track exists to remove. Profiles arrive in SU-4.
_meta.data_note: Universes marked unavailable below reference groups that have no source snapshot yet. Only NIFTY_50, NIFTY_NEXT_50, NIFTY_MIDCAP_100 and 9 sector indices exist in data/index_constituents/. NIFTY_100/200/500, MIDCAP_150, SMALLCAP_250, MICROCAP_250, TOTAL_MARKET and FNO must be obtained before the universes referencing them resolve to anything.

athena_core._note: TODAY'S REAL ATHENA UNIVERSE. Not an index: ATHENA runs on the owner's curated candidate list, and defining this as NIFTY_500 would silently change every engine's universe (ADR-011 section 3.1). Eligibility is 'none' because the resolver applies no group-level filter — ATHENA's own UniverseEngine still runs downstream, unchanged.
athena_core.description: The owner's curated candidate list — what ATHENA ingests and scores today.

darvax_discovery._note: UNAVAILABLE until SU-4. NSE_ALL_ELIGIBLE_EQUITY is rule-defined (ADR-011 section 2.3) and deliberately not materialised, so this resolves only once the darvax_discovery eligibility profile exists.
darvax_discovery.description: Broad NSE equity discovery universe for the DarvaX screener.

mainboard_equity._note: Resolvable today: NSE_MAINBOARD is derived from the symbol master's board classification (SU-2). Applies no eligibility filter, so it includes everything classified as main board regardless of liquidity or history.
mainboard_equity.description: Every symbol classified as NSE main board, unfiltered.

largecap_scanner._note: Resolvable today — NIFTY_50 has a dated snapshot.

midcap_scanner._note: Resolvable today — NIFTY_MIDCAP_100 has a dated snapshot. ADR-011 named NIFTY_MIDCAP_150, which has no snapshot; this uses the index we actually hold rather than fabricating membership.

broad_scanner._note: Resolvable today. NIFTY_TOTAL_MARKET has no snapshot, so this unions the three broad indices actually held. It is NOT a substitute for NIFTY 500 and must not be described as one.
broad_scanner.description: Union of NIFTY 50, Next 50 and Midcap 100 — the broadest index coverage currently held.
